'''Dobbis''' was the name given to a sacred statue by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was associated with the [[Dobbis]], the Gungan [[Deity/Legends|goddess]] of [[Water/Legends|rain]].<ref name="SWGB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' {{C|French edition}}</ref> Located on a rocky ledge near some [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|sacred, ancient ruins]] and connected to the ruins by a path, Dobbis was located next to a wide tree and towered over a waterfall.<ref name="game">''[[Episode I Adventures 11: Pirates from Beyond the Sea]]''</ref> Sometime prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="EpI" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="SWGB" /> the statue had worn down with age, featuring several cracks and vine trails. The Gungan [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] spent several [[Standard day/Legends|afternoons]] sleeping next to the statue.<ref name="EpI" />

Two [[Droid/Legends|droids]] belonging to the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Swagg]] attempted to steal the statue of Dobbis alongside others. Binks stumbled upon the droids loading the statue onto a heavy industrial [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] cart. They fired at Binks, who dove into a decaying obelisk, accidentally knocking it down onto the droids and crushing them. The cart containing the statue lurched forward, but Binks was able to stop it from falling off the cliff and hid the cart and the statue behind a wide [[Tree/Legends|tree]].<ref name="EpI" />
